lines: NRJN Family Trust, represented by Entrust Family Office Legal & Trusteeship Services Private Limited, is an investor selling shareholder, selling up to 1,050,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds are up to ₹141.96 crore if all offered shares are sold; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The call is timely because the money has been in hand since listing, with trading starting March 11, 2026.
Gain is unknown because average cost of acquisition is not verified, and the pre-offer holding is unknown; the name is verified in the seller table, so confidence is medium.
